message.content: I usually wake up around seven, maybe a bit later if I’ve had a rough night. I make a cup of tea and toast, then feed the cat before getting dressed. I take the bus to work, so I leave the house just in time to catch it. My sister lives with me, and we don’t really talk much in the morning. I like the routine—it keeps me grounded, I guess. Sometimes I hear a voice when I’m alone, but it doesn’t happen every day. I don’t know what it means, but it’s been going on for a while now.
